# catalyst_stratus_buckets (Data Source)

List existing Stratus buckets. Requires `ZohoCatalyst.buckets.READ` and Stratus availability in the project. It does not read objects or manage buckets. Bucket names are their documented identities. Results are sorted lexicographically by name. An empty project returns an empty list; denied access or malformed responses return an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "catalyst_stratus_buckets" "example" {
  project_id = var.project_id
}

output "buckets" {
  value = data.catalyst_stratus_buckets.example.buckets
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Existing project's positive numeric ID, written as a string.

### Read-Only

- `buckets` (Attributes List) Existing infrastructure, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--buckets))

<a id="nestedatt--buckets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `buckets`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name reported by Catalyst.
- `url` (String) Bucket HTTPS endpoint reported by Catalyst. The provider does not make requests to this endpoint.
